## how my background shaped these notes

my background in computational biology and healthcare data science made me curious about how we turn messy data into meaningful results.\
as my analyses grew, i began thinking more about how to repeat them and keep track of what had changed.\
working with different datasets also made me question whether a model would behave the same way in a new setting.\
moving from analysis to serving predictions brought new questions about consistency, reliability, and when an input needs a closer look.\
these notes follow that learning process, from building reproducible workflows to understanding how models are used and maintained responsibly.
